parent_objective: audit calibrated four-wheel source-positive rows before actor/history integration
blocked_by: M1271 produced accepted source rows, but source diversity and boundary usefulness must be audited before training or integration
supersedes: direct Gym/actor integration from M1271 source-positive rows

public_gates: M1272 must preserve actor input contract
M1272 must not use private holdout
M1272 must audit source diversity and boundary usefulness
M1272 must decide the next source step before actor/Gym integration
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add per-wheel/fault labels to actor inputs
do not count horizon-only rows as success
do not claim high-fidelity validation from the compact pilot
do not treat source-positive rows as driver performance

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M1271 source-positive rows are diverse and boundary-useful enough for the next source step
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if accepted rows are source-collapsed
stop if accepted rows are too easy for boundary/history tests
stop if actor/Gym integration would require per-wheel/fault input expansion
fallback_plan: if rows are diverse and boundary-useful, admit bounded corpus export or intervention design
if rows are source-collapsed, admit filtering or source-diversity mining
if rows are too easy, admit boundary retargeting around accepted rows
if halfshaft remains inactive, isolate or drop it from the next source corpus
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1271 produced strict source-positive rows that require audit before integration

training_stage.stage_objective: four-wheel source viability calibration result audit
admission_evidence: M1271 did not train, run PPO, promote, or expand actor inputs
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next manifest if audit admits it
next_stage_criteria: audit decides whether to export corpus, filter boundary rows, retarget, or synthesize

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1272 audits source rows only and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until M1272 decides that source rows are suitable
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If M1271 rows are not boundary-useful, route to source filtering/retargeting rather than weakening self-ID criteria.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: The M1271 source-positive rows can be audited for source diversity and boundary usefulness before any actor/history integration.

audit decides whether to export corpus, filter boundary rows, retarget, or synthesize
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: audit treats source-positive rows as driver performance
audit skips directly to actor/Gym integration
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1272 passes if it audits M1271 source-positive rows and selects the next source step without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion.
